ambiguity_effects.phrase: created in the first week of June 2026
ambiguity_effects.explain: Since June 1 2026 is a Monday, the ISO week and the first-7-days reading both give June 1 to 7, while a Sunday to Saturday convention would give May 31 to June 6. This is a genuine ambiguity in general, but in this record set it does not change the outcome, since the only candidate in the disputed margin, hub 9207 created June 7, already fails on the description condition regardless of which reading is used.

This could mean the literal phrase EMEA rollout appears, or that the description references an EMEA rollout in other words. In this record set every description either contains the literal phrase or has no EMEA content at all, so there is no borderline case and the ambiguity does not affect which candidates pass.
